event.marcus_heart2.3.text: I was counting. Yours held, even shaking a little. Set the plank down. Sit a minute.
event.marcus_heart2.3.why: Keeper gentleness replaces the compliment; pairs with the cut tic

event.marcus_heart2.3.text: Most hands drift after a minute. Yours didn't. Short on sleep, though. I was counting that too.
event.marcus_heart2.3.why: too-exact care: he counts your sleep

event.marcus_heart5.4.text: Edmund had a door like that. He wouldn't let me oil it. He wanted to hear it open. That last fall, I understood why.
event.marcus_heart5.4.why: revelation tier approaches Edmund's fate, full only

event.marcus_heart5.4.text: Edmund had a door like that. The cellar. He never let me oil the hinge. A loud hinge tells you when it opens. He wanted to know.
event.marcus_heart5.4.why: clue: the hinge was an alarm, echoing the planted thread

event.marcus_heart5.2.text: The bag is for your fields. Crops can hurry. You walk home in the light, though. Humor me.
event.marcus_heart5.2.why: frightened band: the gift plus the not-after-dark tell

event.hall_dance.0.text: I checked the roof once. Twice. ...Three times, my father said. It is finished. Whatever comes this winter, it holds.
event.hall_dance.0.why: payoff kept ('finished' still lands before Wren's pool line); the assurance a shade too exact

event.hall_dance.11.text: Something that isn't wood. That narrows it. ...One dance. And nobody walks home alone tonight. Carpenter's rule.
event.hall_dance.11.why: the dance stays; the Keeper quietly sets a rule

event.story_pie_payoff.intro.text: A word, quietly. ...No. First, sit a minute. The pie keeps. You walk past the clinic most days, don't you?
event.story_pie_payoff.intro.why: the ask survives but his care comes first

event.story_whistler_marcus.intro.text: Ah. You've found me. I whistle when the grain runs true. And on evenings this quiet. It keeps the quiet honest.
event.story_whistler_marcus.intro.why: small noticing of the village hush

dlg.marcus.roof.0.text: Pitch, rafters, shingles. Drawn nine times. Every time I'm afraid it won't hold. It will hold. It will hold. ...Sit. You look worn through.

dlg.marcus.roof.1.text: Six winters of nearly. Four nights a year the work stops, and I don't say why. ...What would you do?
dlg.marcus.roof.1.why: clue: the Keeper calendar explains the nearly; question kept

event.marcus_birthday.intro.text: My birthday. One plank, planed slow, no customer waiting. You look like a slow hour would do you good. Sit.
event.marcus_birthday.intro.why: he measures the guest's tiredness; invite kept

event.overheard_marcus_dorian_2.l3.text: I nearly got worried. Then I counted your breathing. Best hour of the week.

event.overheard_marcus_dorian_3.l3.text: That's all a door is for. Choosing what side of it a thing stays on.
event.overheard_marcus_dorian_3.l3.why: clue: doors as keeping, toward the forest gate

event.overheard_marcus_dorian_3.l3.text: That's all a door is for. Closing on purpose. Some doors want to be heavier.
event.overheard_marcus_dorian_3.l3.why: hint grade of the same thought

event.overheard_marcus_dorian_4.l3.text: Facing the owl. Introductions before the new moon. I'll hurry the glass.
event.overheard_marcus_dorian_4.l3.why: a man who never hurries sets a new-moon deadline; joke shape kept

event.overheard_bram_marcus_3.l4.text: Bring them Wednesday. Side by side, in the light. ...In the light. Lunch to the straighter.
event.overheard_bram_marcus_3.l4.why: repetition distortion; the contest insists on daylight

event.overheard_marcus_odalys_2.l3.text: Nobody sits on it. That's why it worked loose. Things loosen when nobody keeps them.
event.overheard_marcus_odalys_2.l3.why: Keeper thesis in carpenter's words, mild-safe

event.overheard_marcus_odalys_3.l2.text: Better. I rest it Wednesdays. Doctor's orders. She knows what this back carries.
event.overheard_marcus_odalys_3.l2.why: clue: a duty and its cost, between the leader and him

adds.text: One more thing. The dark comes down fast off the lane. Make a habit of beating it home.
adds.why: hint: his not-alone-after-dark tell, planted early

adds.text: It's full dark, though. I'll walk you as far as the lane. The tune carries better with two.
adds.why: hint: the evening scene ends with an escort home

cuts.why: performing the measure tic at a frightened player reads strange; he drops it and is plain; the .3 frightened variant fills the beat

threads.marcus_heart2: Why does the carpenter count your steadiness, your sleep, and the daylight you have left?
threads.marcus_heart5: Why did Edmund want a cellar hinge loud enough to hear open?
threads.hall_dance: Why does the happiest night of the year end with a rule about walking home alone?
threads.story_pie_payoff: Why does the carpenter check how you are holding up before he asks a favor?
threads.story_whistler_marcus: What does his whistling keep honest on quiet evenings, and why does he walk you to the lane?
threads.story_pumpkin_marcus: Left plain on purpose; the pumpkin is only a pumpkin, and the contrast matters.
threads.marcus_heart8: What stops the carpenter's work four nights a year, always the same nights?
threads.marcus_birthday: Why does he measure his guest's tiredness more carefully than his birthday plank?
threads.overheard_marcus_dorian_1: Left plain; the straight plank stays only a plank.
threads.overheard_marcus_dorian_2: What was Marcus counting through an hour of silence with his lodger?
threads.overheard_marcus_dorian_3: Which door do the carpenter and the forager think should be heavier?
threads.overheard_marcus_dorian_4: Why must the window toward the trees be glazed before the new moon?
threads.overheard_bram_marcus_1: Left plain; the bench friendship is the game's safest ground.
threads.overheard_bram_marcus_2: Left plain; a handle that vanishes in the hand needs no shadow.
threads.overheard_bram_marcus_3: Why does the nail contest insist, twice, on being held in the light?
threads.overheard_marcus_odalys_1: Left plain; the knees joke carries the scene.
threads.overheard_marcus_odalys_2: What loosens in Wetherell when nobody keeps it?
threads.overheard_marcus_odalys_3: What does the doctor know Marcus's back carries besides beams?

notes: hall_dance: the dread variant of .0 keeps 'finished' so Wren's pool line still pays off; build order unchanged.
The dorian_4 new-moon deadline matches the Keeper calendar without naming it; mild-safe by the banned list.
heart5 revelation variant approaches Edmund's last fall; full-only per tier rule, never confesses.
whistler add attaches after the scene's final spoken line; Director confirm the engine allows an add there, else move it after dlg close.
Bram scenes mostly untouched on purpose: he is unaware and the bench must stay the safest place in the game.
